movement, and includes a fresh flower from Firene pinned to the breast.

and scarf ward off the cold of even the snowiest of days.

eyes, and the tinted lenses can be useful when going incognito.

but some say the striking effect on their image is worth it.

Everyday outfit of Bunet, Prince Fogado's retainer. He's worn it daily 
since his time in the canteen, so it must be washed frequently.

Everyday outfit of Boucheron, Prince Alfred's retainer. The buttons seem 
to be on the verge of snapping off, but they've held out this long.

Clothing worn by Brodian nobles, usually at festive events, this design

Clothing worn by Brodian nobles. Made with very thick and warm fabric,

Brodian clothes sent as a token of friendship. White faux leather

Brodian clothing sent as a token of friendship. White faux leather

Everyday outfit of Céline, princess of Firene. The ribbons provide the

Everyday outfit of Chloé, Princess Céline's retainer. Though she often

Everyday outfit of Citrinne, Prince Alcryst's retainer. The jacket is made

Everyday outfit of Clanne, 33rd Steward of the Dragon. Has a special

Sweet sunglasses with gradient brown lenses. They're popular with 
fashion-conscious folks who also want some protection from the sun.

a teacher.

Based on Corrin, the Emblem of Fates. A royal whose blood is that

Based on Leif, the Emblem of Genealogy. A brave prince in whose veins

Clothes designed at the boutique specially for training, made in a unique

A mask chiefly worn to Firenese masquerades, where people from all

MAID_H_SolumFormal3M:
Solmic clothing sent as a token of friendship. Inspired by a famous legend,

Everyday outfit of Alcryst, prince of Brodia. While he sees only the 
differences with Diamant's outfit, the truth is they're quite similar.

Highly ornamented swimwear for youths. The delightful ribbon on the

MAID_H_Swimwear3M:
Highly ornamented swimwear for youths. Fresh tropical flowers that never

Everyday outfit of Amber, Prince Diamant's retainer. The embroidery on

Everyday outfit worn by Vander, 32nd Steward of the Dragon.

Everyday outfit for Veyle, daughter of the Fell Dragon. She pays little 
attention to her attire, so her fashion-conscious friends chose this outfit.

Everyday outfit of Yunaka, eccentric thief. She fashioned this chic outfit

Everyday outfit of Zelkov, Princess Ivy's retainer. The purpose of the 
multiple belts is unclear, but the key is known to be purely decorative.

MID_AFTER_Alfred_Text:
As king of Firene, Alfred forged a 
new non-aggression pact with 
Lythos and the other countries, 
ensuring a long period of peace. 

Records reveal Alfred's reign 
was brief, as he died an early 
death. However, he was loved by 
his people, and there is no doubt 
his life was full of joy.

Anna finally reunited with her 
family. She had many sisters, all

Bunet rebuilt his parents' bistro. 
It became wildly popular for 
serving dishes beloved by Solm 
royalty as well as .

taste food, putting all he learned 
into a book that became a bible 
for chefs. Even after his death,

MID_AFTER_Boucheron_Text:
Boucheron worked for many 
years to restore Firene. Upon 
seeing Florra Port fully restored, 
he cried tears of joy. 

He traveled so often between the 
castle and Florra that, in honor 
of his kindness and dedication, 
the road connecting them was 
called Boucheron's Passage.

MID_AFTER_Celine_Text:
Céline dedicated her life to peace 
in the kingdom of Firene. This 
sometimes meant taking the 
unpopular position of punishing 
those who disturbed order. 

Her favorite tea became known 
as a tea of blessings in Firene. 
Legend had it that those who 
drank the tea would find joy.

Chloé comforted the royal family 
and her fellow soldiers with 
deliveries of folk food. Soon, 
Firene's local delicacies started

at a food stall, and they had a 
fairy-tale, whirlwind romance 
that blossomed into lifelong love.

Citrinne redoubled her efforts to 
sway Brodian nobles away from 
warfare by advocating for peace. 
Some were unmoved, but many 
took her words to heart. 

Despite the great weight on her 
shoulders, her graceful smile was 
ever present─especially at the 
balls and galas that she so loved.

MID_AFTER_Diamand_Text:
As the new king of Brodia, 
Diamant ordered a halt to all 
invasions and worked to reform 
his people's attitudes on Elusia. 

Some nobles resisted Diamant at 
first, but his vision for the future 
earned their favor. By exporting 
ore, Brodia was able to shift to a 
booming, trade-based economy.

MID_AFTER_Etie_Text:
Besides serving Firene with her 
own strength, Etie bulked up its 
soldiers with a regimen of weight 
training and muscle stimulants. 

Some said this was at odds with 
the nation's pacifist ethos, but it 
was celebrated in her hometown, 
where to this day, orange flowers 
are grown in her honor.

Fogado traveled aimlessly until 
Timerra's coronation and then 
returned to the palace to serve 
behind the scenes as her adviser. 

Though few reliable accounts of 
his life were left in the history 
books, it's said he met someone 
during his travels, and they spent 
the rest of their lives together.

contest for all the candidates.

Though she was dubbed a knight 
for her service, Goldmary soon

So many of her students went on 
to do great things that she felt a 
need to apologize to her classes 
for the pressure placed on them.

Hortensia returned to Elusia's 
academy and soon graduated 
at the top of her class. 

Her natural charm was later key 
in negotiations with Brodia. She 
and Ivy were well remembered 
for the contributions they made 
to their country's prosperity.

MID_AFTER_Ivy_Text:
As queen of Elusia, Ivy strove to 
rebuild her war-torn nation, and 
to improve its insular culture 
through diplomacy with Brodia. 
Her decision to import ore gave 
rise to a lucrative mineral 
processing industry. 

Ivy's legacy endured even after 
had passed on.

MID_AFTER_Jade_Text:
Jade celebrated Diamant's rise 
to the Brodian throne with pride, 
and further dedicated herself to 
Brodia as a knight of the king. 

She always found time to write, 
despite her busy schedule, and 
managed to complete over 100 
humor novels in her lifetime, all 
celebrated as masterpieces.

Jean became a great doctor, and 
after taking over his father's 
clinic, he visited Lythos once a 
month to make house calls. 

Passionate about researching 
new medicines, Jean found his 
village's famous tea leaves could 
be developed into a panacea. His 
discovery was studied for years.

Kagetsu disappeared after Ivy's 
coronation. Some said he was off 
searching for a worthy opponent.

in Elusia and serve the queen. 

Working under Ivy, he still made 
visits to Pale Sands, returning 
each time with the gift of rice.

Lapis traveled to war-torn towns 
and taught citizens how to repair 
their homes. At every stop, she 
left large, delicious potatoes from 
the farm in her home village. 

The popularity of these "taters" 
brought her village wealth and 
prosperity, and earned Lapis a 
new title: "the Potato Goddess."

morning, returning to the side of 
his beloved wife in the hereafter. 

For his friends and allies, his 
memory lives on whenever they 
taste a pastry or hear the sound 
of thunder roaring in the sky.

preferred to stroll gardens alone.

He patrolled the kingdom to quell

Veyle took over Gradlon and

than other units.

MCID_M005_OUTLINE:
Upon learning that Elusia invaded 
Firene Castle, the Divine Dragon's 
army hastens to Queen Ève.
MCID_M006_OUTLINE:
Having regained Firene Castle, the 
party heads to a shrine housing 
the Ring of the Dawn Maiden.
MCID_M007_OUTLINE:
The party attempts to cross the 
border to obtain the ring entrusted 
to the Kingdom of Brodia.
MCID_M008_OUTLINE:
After rebuffing an Elusian attack, 
the Divine Dragon's army reaches 
their destination: Brodia Castle.
MCID_M009_OUTLINE:
The Divine Dragon's army and King 
Morion head to Elusia's border to 
answer King Hyacinth's challenge.
MCID_M010_OUTLINE:
The Divine Dragon's army rushes 
to Destinea Cathedral to rescue 
King Morion.
MCID_M012_OUTLINE:
Their rings lost to Veyle, the party 
heads to the Queendom of Solm to 
regain their footing.
MCID_M013_OUTLINE:
The Divine Dragon's army travels 
to an oasis in search of Timerra 
and the Ring of the Radiant Hero.
MCID_M014_OUTLINE:
Receiving word of Hortensia's 
attack, the Divine Dragon's army 
hastens back to Solm Palace.
MCID_M015_OUTLINE:
Victorious at Solm Palace, the 
party seeks the Ring of the Crux 
of Fate at the Northern Fortress.
MCID_M016_OUTLINE:
While planning their next move 
after getting a new ring, the Divine 
Dragon's army receives a report.
MCID_M017_OUTLINE:
Chasing Elusian warships heading 
to Firene, the Divine Dragon's army 
arrives at Florra Port.
MCID_M018_OUTLINE:
Having learned the truth about 
Veyle, the party heads to Elusia, 
where the Fell Dragon waits.
MCID_M019_OUTLINE:
The Divine Dragon's army arrives 
at a lively Elusian port after 
fending off attackers at sea.
MCID_M020_OUTLINE:
After recovering two rings from 
Marni and Mauvier, the party 
reaches Elusia Castle at last.
MCID_M021_OUTLINE:
Having learned a harsh truth from 
Griss, the party pursues the Fell 
Dragon to Lythos Castle.
MCID_M023_OUTLINE:
Seeking to break the barrier in the 
sky above Elyos, the party hunts 
down a Fell Dragon Shard.
MCID_M024_OUTLINE:
Armed with a powerful artifact 
from Zephia, the party heads to a 
lake in pursuit of a sunken shard.
MCID_M025_OUTLINE:
After meeting the Divine Dragon's 
past self, only one shard remains. 
But a dark surprise lies in wait...
MCID_S001_OUTLINE:
Can the Divine's Dragon army save 
the residents of a peaceful village 
when the Corrupted attack?
MCID_S002_OUTLINE:
In a bandit stronghold, a little thief 
is looking for treasure.
